expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Constructs the value from the supplied representation. Normalizes the value. Performs size. Performs size squared. Converts or derives log. Converts or derives exp. Converts or derives inverse. Performs angular distance.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Observe receiver, object, collection, callback, diagnostic, or lifecycle state after each void call.
inputs: Nominal values for every listed parameter, one default or empty state, and one behavior-specific boundary derived from the registration notes.
